Hydra delivers sub-second finality, near-zero fees, and high parallel throughput with L1-grade settlement.
It unlocks verticals such as institutional and perpetual DEXes, agent-to-agent commerce, micropayments, gaming, point of sale, and verifiable information processing.
Executive Summary Enabling high-performance applications on Cardano through production hardening and performance improvements of Hydra v2.
What is Hydra Hydra is a Layer 2 state channel for Cardano.
Instead of every transaction going through Cardano's main network, which takes minutes to hours and incurs non-trivial fees.
Hydra lets users transact instantly and at near-zero cost among themselves.
